title: September 15, 2026 City Council Meeting
summary: Downtown business investment, two executive appointments, traffic-signal construction, affordable and supportive housing, and a proposed restructuring of City advisory bodies.

title: September 1, 2026 City Council Meeting
summary: Verified decisions on sustainability, short-term rentals, e-bike safety, sponsorships, a digital billboard proposal, and Beaumont Nights.

title: August 18, 2026 City Council Meeting
summary: Animal sheltering, a future recreation center, transit infrastructure, emergency preparedness, and investment oversight.

title: August 4, 2026 City Council Meeting
summary: Transportation funding, a new five-year economic strategy, year-end finances, and revised City priorities.

title: July 21, 2026 City Council Meeting
summary: Capital projects, infrastructure, public spending, and long-range planning — explained in plain English.

title: June 16, 2026 City Council Meeting
summary: The annual budget, Community Facilities District taxes, fire protection, sponsorship policy, and employee agreements — with verified outcomes.

title: June 2, 2026 City Council Meeting
summary: Baldwin Ranch service districts, transit planning, capital-project funding, downtown business grants, street safety, Stewart Park, and wastewater solar generation.

title: May 5, 2026
summary: Council unanimously approved the entire consent calendar, the TEFRA financing resolution, major design and event-service agreements, and several infrastructure actions. Council received a Stewart Park progress report, directed staff toward an outsourced short-term-rental program, and removed the sponsorship-policy item for a later meeting.

title: April 21, 2026
summary: With three members present, Council unanimously approved the consent calendar, updated development-related fees, initiated two Baldwin Ranch CFD annexations, awarded a five-year environmental-monitoring agreement, and amended the Deputy City Manager employment agreement.

title: April 7, 2026
summary: Council unanimously approved the consent calendar and most action items, including a downtown business grant, investment-management contract, City Manager appointment, public-meeting disruption policy, a three-year Drone First Responder agreement, sewer-project closeout, Strategic Plan updates, and a wireless sublease. Items J.3 and J.4 were postponed to April 21.

title: March 17, 2026
summary: Council approved the consent calendar, a manhole-replacement contract, two $5,000 community sponsorships, and the 2026 Legislative Platform. It received the truck-prohibition update and directed staff to press for resolution of the Stewart Park grant delay before returning on May 5.

title: March 3, 2026
summary: Council advanced updates to regional transportation fees and subdivision rules, approved Tentative Tract Map 38926, increased the IOA Championship contribution to $40,000, and approved a consulting amendment. It received the billboard survey and City leasehold inventory and directed further work on public facilities and short-term-rental regulation.

title: February 17, 2026
summary: Council amended the capital improvement plan, adopted a neighborhood traffic program, selected the City-owned Beaumont Avenue and Cougar Way site for the 2026 Cherry Festival, extended Fairway Canyon sewer emergency authority, approved mid-year budget changes and a second homeless liaison officer, and set direction for recycled water, wayfinding signs, and the remaining 2026 meeting calendar.
